answer: Reputation accrues only through verified work, so fresh clones carry no shale-weighted history. Agents must stake a bonded deposit of sable tokens locked for the epoch; a sybil attacker registering many identities must post this stake per identity, making mass registration costly. Honest agents earn a haven of persistent standing that unlocks higher-value tasks, while duplicate identities collapse under shared stake slashing. This model fits agent sa0014's threat model.
